current_law_status: NO CURRENT BINDING LAW GOVERNS INTERPOLATION. What follows is the conservative constituted position plus the historical evidence, with the residual marked for HQ.

current_capability.statement: No time-grain vocabulary exists in the current DAG. The only time-adjacent slots are allowed_effective_time_or_interval_refs (a tuple of ExactRef), effective_period (free Mapping) and time_geography_applicability (free Mapping). None is typed.

historical_evidence.statement: V553 forced a POINT-YEAR calendar anchor per wave, refused to treat a wave ordinal as a year, and refused duplicate anchors per year. Fieldwork intervals were not represented.

constituted_grains.note: Commission O5 lists it and case C depends on it, but nothing establishes it.

no_implicit_midpoint_or_year_coercion.statement: Binding. HQD-125 §10 requires exact identity authority; V553's refusal to coerce an ordinal to a year is the concrete constraint to conserve.

FORK.question: For MULTI-SOURCE comparison, is temporal identity keyed on a point year or on a fieldwork interval?
why_it_is_underdetermined: V553's point-year choice was adequate for a single-family, single-country track and is NOT established as adequate for comparing two families with nonaligned fieldwork intervals.
No binding law names a time grain at all.
The current slots are untyped, so nothing currently prevents a caller from smuggling a midpoint year.
Case C cannot be answered without deciding this.
FORK.consequence_if_wrong: Either a fabricated common time base (silently manufacturing comparability) or a refusal of lawful cross-family comparison (silently losing it).
FORK.scope_limit: This fork BLOCKS case C cross-family temporal comparison. It does NOT block case A same-survey F7, where point-year is conservative and adequate.

four_layers_kept_separate.note: Keeping the word CANDIDATE is the entire safeguard.

four_layers_kept_separate.authority: V553_RUPTURE_EVENT_SLOT_LEDGER_SCHEMA with rupture_override_status = 'reserved_not_filled' on every row
four_layers_kept_separate.note: No external-event authority was ever established. Conserve the slot; bind nothing.
'causal' occurs ZERO times in the 4187-line V553 temporal pressure module. There is no historical machinery and no current law.

O7_rupture_and_causal_explanation.rule: Temporal coincidence must never become causal authority. Naming a cause for a temporal break requires NEW authority that exists in no evidence class.
required_authority_before_naming_a_cause: an established event authority (the reserved slot must be filled by an accountable authority, not by inference)
a typed rupture classification distinct from the candidate
an explicit causal claim contract with its own falsification test

was_interpolation_ever_binding_authority.statement: NO. It was policy-gated provisional implementation. V553 gates it behind an explicit allow_interpolation boolean, defaults to gap_marked_unknown, labels rows temporal_scope='year_interpolated' and pressure_status='interpolated', and records a policy ledger. 'cautious_interpolation_allowed' is the source authority status.

should_gaps_remain_typed_unknown_by_defa.statement: YES. This is both the historical default and the constituted position. Nothing in current law authorises interpolation, so the conservative default is a typed unknown.

what_authority_would_be_needed_to_interp: an explicit, operation-scoped interpolation authority reference
a named, non-obsolete interpolation method (linear_between_authorized_waves is obsolete)
a declared uncertainty/penalty representation for the synthesized value
a statement of which account the interpolated value may satisfy — an interpolated period may not silently become an observation

current_law_answer.statement: NO. Conserving the constraint is correct and conservative: crossing a rupture candidate with a synthesized value would manufacture continuity across a detected discontinuity.

how_uncertainty_and_penalty_are_represen.statement: V553_CONFIDENCE_PENALTY_LEDGER_SCHEMA and V553_PRESSURE_BASIS_LEDGER_SCHEMA carry it as a first-class ledger; the current DAG has allowed_uncertainty_states as a typed-state tuple on structural admission.

O8_interpolation.INTERPOLATION != OBSERVATION: Binding. An interpolated value must carry an interpolated marker in its own right and may never be counted as an observed wave.

O6_disagreement.slot_defect: Validated only as a NON-EMPTY STRING with no enumerated vocabulary. A caller could name an averaging policy in free text with no structural refusal.
lawful_options: preserve plural observations as separate source-indexed facts (IMPLEMENTED via SOURCE_INDEXED_MULTI_UNIVERSE)
O6_disagreement.forbidden: an averaged synthetic value, unless exact composition authority admits it. SOURCE_CONFLICT != AVERAGE_BY_DEFAULT is binding and must become structural, not textual.
O6_disagreement.note: The fix is to enumerate the policy vocabulary and refuse averaging by default. That is bounded implementation under the present DAG, not architecture reopen.

absence_law.ABSENCE != ZERO: Binding. V553_TEMPORAL_GAP_AND_ABSENCE_INDEX_SCHEMA makes absence an indexed observation. anchor_copy must not be inherited.
absence_law.NONCOMPARABLE != NO_CHANGE: Binding AND CURRENTLY IMPLEMENTED. EMPIRICAL_FACT_NONCOMPARABLE is an enumerated refusal with reason codes in pre553_structural_admission.py.
